description: Opens the avatar in the Ania Player on the user’s computer through Ania Link. If the Player is not paired, explains how (Remote control in the Player settings shows a code; then link_player). Private avatars get a download link to open in the Player.

avatarId.description: Avatar id from meus_avatares or a finished job.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

name: open_in_player
title: Open in Ania Player
